description.summary: You animate a bone with dark energy, giving it the power to float near your body and interpose itself against physical attacks
description.value: You animate a bone with dark energy, giving it the power to float near your body and interpose itself against physical attacks. This gives you damage reduction 10/-. Once the bone shield has prevented a total of 10 points of damage per caster level (maximum 200 points), it is destroyed and the spell is discharged.
